title: Apple Intelligence App Discoverability
headline: Apple just opened a new discovery layer for apps.
description: Apple’s App Intents, App Entities, Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts, and Home Screen search are creating a new discovery layer for customer-facing apps. Sunder helps teams understand what it means and how to prepare.
